author: GGJJ
text:
Hi omidfxt,

You mentioned that you often missed just a few pips. I was wondering why
 you did not increase a few pips between the entry and SL. This will
increase your overall profits. If you seek max RR as much as possible
every time, I can understand it.

I often keep entry and SL 10-20 pips, With 10 pips, SL got hit very
often, and then market turned to my favour, it is annoying. I have to
keep more pips between entry and SL, clearly it is because my entry
point is not good.

Your journal is brilliant, help me a lot.

hey GGJJ

I think the main reason i missed some of my Limit orders was because i
wasn't enough accurate ! another reasons was that in the past i wasn't
looking at the price while approaching my limit orders. in that case i
could get in the trade by the first signs that price showed to starting
the reversal and in the recent trade that i post i tried to do it

and about the 10-20 pips stop, i usually try to find my edges and then
put the stop at a defined place(usually above the FL that i'm
trading+spread) and it doesn't matter for me if it's 10 pips, 3 pips or
whatever and as you mentioned i usually try to take the trade with max
R:R and at the most extreme edges. that's why sometimes i missed some
trades!

and thanks for your kind words buddy

yes actually that was what i think about it

there was a FL that hold the price and didn't let it go up, a clear

actually decided to start the up move. So this can be our most important
 area for paying attention to

and after engulfing this new FL(not your yellow zone(QM) but the the
limit of our flag below it) depend on the situation of the chart , price
 can go to the next FL
